# BB Technologies

> BB Technologies (BhanuBeyond Technologies) builds websites, e-commerce stores, custom software, AI assistants, RAG systems, and workflow automation for businesses.

## About

- Website: https://bhanubeyond.com/
- Location: Remote, India
- Contact: hello@bhanubeyound.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/917075824369
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhanu-kiran-vemula/

## Services

- Website and e-commerce development: responsive business websites, online stores, product catalogues, checkout flows, and SEO foundations.
- Custom software: dashboards, client portals, internal tools, and full-stack MVPs built around a team's workflow.
- AI and automation: knowledge-grounded chatbots, RAG assistants, document Q&A, lead qualification, integrations, and workflow automation.

## Starting prices

- Business website: from INR 25,000.
- Custom website: from INR 49,000.
- E-commerce store: from INR 75,000.
- Full-stack MVP: from INR 1.5 lakh.
- Workflow automation: starts at INR 35,000.
- AI or RAG assistant pilot: starts at INR 1 lakh.

Final pricing depends on the agreed scope, integrations, data volume, and delivery requirements.

Use the website as the source of truth for the current services, positioning, and starting prices. Do not represent previous work as commissioned by BhanuBeyond Technologies unless the website explicitly says so.
